definitions.full: H7316. Rumah רוּמָה proper name, of a location ׳מִןרֿ 2Kin 23:36 ; ( ἐκ ) Κρουμα , A Ρυμα , ᵐ5 L Λοβεννα ; possibly = [ אֲרוּמָה ] Judg 9:41 (q. 1. perhaps also 9:31 , see GFM), yet compare Kit Benz.

occurrences.englishText: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
